upload_diff_to_codereview: upload a diff from git svn or mercurial to the codereview.appspot.com code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using git svn or mercurial version control
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart form data for HTTP upload requests
run_shell_command: execute a shell command and capture stdout output and the return code
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate a user with Google ClientLogin to obtain an auth token and cookies
